description: Use this when an uploaded PDF fails the print check because content is too close to the edge or pages are neither A4 nor US Letter. mode "shrink" (default) scales the affected pages down slightly and centres them on their paper (US Letter for a US Letter PDF, else A4); nothing is lost. mode "crop" keeps pages at 100 % and removes everything inside the margin band, so that content is NOT printed (pages of other sizes are first fitted onto A4). The US Letter pages of a mixed PDF that already fit on A4 keep their placement. The original upload is kept; calling again with the other mode replaces the earlier fix. If content touches the edge, ask the user which mode they prefer and tell them what changed. Not possible once the letter is paid. Needs the user's account.

document_id.description: document_id returned by upload_document or compose_letter, e.g. doc_2h7k9m4q8x1v3c6b0n5p.

mode.description: "shrink" = scale pages down slightly, nothing lost; "crop" = keep 100 % size and cut off everything inside the margin (that content is not printed). Default "shrink".

name: fix_document_margins
title: Fix document margins
